name: jev.skill-router
description: Level 5 routing (Laya skill-routing lane): pick the one skill for a task.

skill.instructions: Which skill should handle this task

criteria.jev-everywhere: Any typed semantic judgment: triage, routing, classification, screening, gating
criteria.lv-draft: Writing or rewriting a LinkedIn post body
criteria.lv-hooks: A post needs an opening line, first line, or hook
criteria.lv-engage: Comments, replies, or engagement cadence on LinkedIn
criteria.lv-outreach: Writing the messages: DMs, connection-request notes, or a warm follow-up DM sequence to specific people
criteria.rig-s1gate: Score an artifact against a rubric with the gate CLI
criteria.darius-linkedin-outreach-agent: Queueing or sending an already-planned batch campaign: conference or cold outreach DMs at volume, sequence sends
criteria.jake-bridge: Daily briefing, what is on today, status of the day
criteria.d85-compliance-checklist: Run the D85 build-certification gates (checklist, verify-cert, ProofPacket seal) before claiming a RIG build is done or certified
criteria.gate-d-loop: An outward or irreversible action needs typed approval
criteria.tac-plan: Multi-step coding task needing a plan before edits
criteria.web-search: Facts beyond cutoff or fresh information lookup

rules.reason: skill confidence at or below 0.90: human or meta-router decides
no listed skill fits: human or meta-router decides

notes.verdicts: PASS = load the chosen skill (confidence above 0.90, not 'other'). ESCALATE = load the when-* meta-skill router instead.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
